messages:
eli (SRE): quick follow-up from the postmortem — recurring partial responses & reconnects on streaming endpoints. I sketched an action table, please confirm owners/ETAs.

samir (eng-runtime): thanks. suspect 3 root causes: heartbeat window too tight, client reconnect jitter, and a KV cache race on session resume. I can take the runtime patches.

marta (infra): I can add gateway capacity and bump ELB idle timeout. Will open INF-2342, targeting Wed EOD.

ryan (product): please prioritize LiveChat and Agent flows. Also we should prepare a short advisory for customers in case we need to communicate.

eli (SRE): action items (tick boxes below) — please ack and add notes on the board (BOARD-512):
- samir: implement backoff + jitter + retry window change (PR #6781), ETA Tue 4pm
- samir: add `stream_fragment_id` telemetry and tag resume/handshake events, ETA Mon noon
- marta: ELB timeout + extra gateway nodes (INF-2342), ETA Wed EOD
- ops: add detection alerts for partials > 0.5% and median recovery > 3s
- ryan: customer comms draft & review, ETA Thu

ops-bot: deploy job created: https://deploy.redwood/jenkins/job/streaming-fix/45 :gear:

samir (eng-runtime): putting up PRs today. quick config snippet I'm testing:```
retry_window: 30s
backoff: exp
base: 200ms
max_retries: 5
```I'll link PRs shortly (will include unit & integration test for resume path).

marta (infra): noted. adding `stream_fragment_id` to trace schema and logs, will file LOG-122 and update parsers. Also will run a small capacity test against staging tomorrow.

eli (SRE): cadence: weekly 15m sync Fridays 10:00am starting next week. recurring invite sent to @samir @marta @ryan.

ryan (product): metrics to validate: `stream.partials_rate`, `stream.reconnect_median_s`, and percent of sessions with >1 resume. Need dashboards and alert ON before Wed.

samir (eng-runtime): ack. I'll add alerts:
- `stream.partials_rate > 0.5%` over 10m
- `stream.reconnect_median_s > 3s` over 5m
and create `streaming-recovery` runbook section with remediation steps.

eli (SRE): summary — owners assigned, infra + runtime changes, observability enhancements, and customer comms. Move progress to BOARD-512 and ping me if blockers. thanks :thumbsup:
